item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 社区今天围绕 Spark 生态资助计划展开密集互动：生态负责人发布了 Q2 成果总览，多个项目方跟进付款与提案进度，同时开发者 xxuejie 分享了一款基于 CKB 的链上游戏实验，引发技术讨论。[S06, S08, S02, S04, S05] ## 重点话题 **Spark Q2 生态成果出炉**：xingtianchunyan 发布季度总结，fiber-checkout 与 ckb-probe 两个延期项目正式结项，前者已上线 npm 包与"Pay with Fiber"支付按钮，后者交付了网络探测工具。[S06] **多项资助款项发放**：委员会集中支付了 invisibook M2、Pocket Node M4、Fiber Link M3 及 Fiber Desktop 等项目的里程碑款项，并公布了链上交易哈希。[S13, S14, S15] **项目方催促进度**：Cell Sandbox 作者 zynor 询问反馈更新，Dular 团队 duongja 提醒尽快处理周期性付款以保障后续里程碑验证。[S02, S05] **CKB Builder Lab 提案收窄**：devnash 根据委员会反馈缩小了 MVP 范围，将原本过于庞大的多模块方案聚焦到可交付的核心功能上。[S04] **链上游戏新实验**：xxuejie 分享了 Teeworlds on CKB 项目，采用"chunk"设计将争议解决转化为有界 CKB-VM 执行；ArthurZhang 跟进讨论该技术原语能否提升为 CKB 原生机制。[S08, S09] ##...

item.title: Nervous Network World3 Trader/Dapp/Machine Signaling (1 posts)
item.description: Every intelligent system needs a nervous system. Most agent projects are still building from raw reflexes — price feeds, simple rules, or black-box models that forget their own history the moment the next block arrives. What’s missing is recurrent memory that actually learns from the shape of its own decisions. We’ve spent the last stretch of work building exactly that: a K-Nacci recurrent lattice that turns every decision path into a living, history-aware structure. Edge detection, path probability mass, transition dynamics, and outcome-weighted updates all live inside the same recurrent state space. The lattice doesn’t just score opportunities — it remembers how it arrived at them and...

item.title: Design notes: verifying CKB state inside other chains (EVM-first, built on RFC 44/45) (1 posts)
item.description: This is exactly the catch I was hoping posting would surface, thank you. You’re right that it hits my design, and you’ve named the precise spot. My inclusion path proved MMR membership against a stored root but didn’t bind recency. Since the MMR is append-only, membership is permanent, so a relayer could replay a once-valid header against a retained root and it would verify. Lower-bounding confirmations doesn’t help because that’s the wrong side of the bound. The fix is the height bound you describe: prove the block sits within the last W blocks of the current tip, membership checked against that tip’s root, not any historical one. Two-sided bound, both halves mandatory. I’ve written it...
